label: Flood risk
unit: FEMA NRI inland-flooding risk index score (0-100, higher is riskier)
description: FEMA National Risk Index score for inland flooding, from 0 to 100 against all U.S. areas, where higher is riskier. It combines expected losses with how vulnerable and resilient the community is, averaged over the town's census tracts by population. A few small towns have no census tract centered inside them and use the tract around the town center instead.
source: FEMA National Risk Index, census tract layer (Inland Flooding, IFLD_RISKS)
